pool.b.praemie_verlangt_lage: I have delivered in recent weeks, and the pay slip does not show it.
The goals and the work rate speak for me, the payroll does not.
pool.b.praemie_verlangt_lage.hitzig: I run myself into the ground and all I get is a handshake when it comes to money!
Others cash in for less, and I am left with nothing!
pool.b.praemie_verlangt_lage.loyal: I do not like asking for money, but my performances deserve a sign.
I am happy here, but a thank-you in my account would be fair.
pool.b.praemie_verlangt_lage.ehrgeizig: I am playing at top level and want my contract to reflect it.
Whoever leads from the front wants to be paid at the front.
pool.b.praemie_verlangt_lage.wechselfreu: If my form is worth nothing here, it will be worth something elsewhere.
My market value has risen, and I know that quite precisely.
pool.b.praemie_verlangt_lage.sensibel: It is hard for me to bring this up, but I do not feel seen.
I do not want to seem cheeky, but I feel overlooked.
pool.b.trainingskritik_lage: Training has lately been more of a duty than progress for me.
I feel the sessions are passing me by.
pool.b.trainingskritik_lage.hitzig: These sessions are a waste of time, and we run like hamsters in a wheel!
Whoever thought this up has never kicked a ball!
pool.b.trainingskritik_lage.loyal: I always pull my weight in training, but a few things go against the grain.
You know my commitment, so I say openly what is wrong in training.
pool.b.trainingskritik_lage.ehrgeizig: I want to get better, and the way we train I am stagnating.
For my development, what we are doing brings me too little.
pool.b.trainingskritik_lage.wechselfreud: I trained differently elsewhere, and it got me further there.
At other clubs the daily training looks different, and I like that.
pool.b.trainingskritik_lage.sensibel: After sessions I am often so spent that I am embarrassed to say so.
Sometimes I arrive at the pitch with a knot in my stomach, and that should not be part of sport.
pool.b.spielerrat_wunsch_lage: I am here on behalf of the squad, there is a request that matters to the lads.
The squad has sent me ahead, it is about something that weighs on all of us.
pool.b.spielerrat_wunsch_lage.hitzig: The dressing room is boiling, and I have no desire to cover for it any longer!
The lads are angry, and I am supposed to take the flak!
pool.b.spielerrat_wunsch_lage.loyal: I stand behind you, but the squad needs a sign from you.
I carry your line outwards, but this time I have to ask for something for the group.
pool.b.spielerrat_wunsch_lage.ehrgeizig: We want to achieve something this season, and for that the mood has to be right.
A team that wants to win has to stay together, and for that we need something from you.
pool.b.spielerrat_wunsch_lage.wechselfre: A few in the dressing room are already looking out of the window, and I would like to avoid that.
If nothing moves, one or two will look for a new club.
pool.b.spielerrat_wunsch_lage.sensibel: The mood in the team is cracked, and I would like to heal it.
I can feel the lads going quiet, and that worries me.
